fields.description: Save signature; raw bytes 0x04..0x07 read 54 52 41 57 ('TRAW'), preserved from stub and verified against baseline.sav
fields.evidence: Raw bytes at save offsets 0x04..0x07 are 54 52 41 57 ('TRAW'), matching the verified stub magic_signature at offset 4. The EEPROM transfer driver itself is absent from this 436-function decomp slice (no 0x0D000000/0x0E000000 references); the closest save-validity idiom is the data-present predicate FUN_0802fe84 (returns *DAT_0802fe94 == 1), called from the menu boot path FUN_0802e300.
fields.name: save_magic_traw

fields.description: Header configuration byte at save offset 0x09 (baseline 0x07)
fields.evidence: Non-blank header byte; selection/config values in this binary are stored through bounded-index idioms such as FUN_0802e300 (stores selected u16 index to *DAT_0802e440 after checking uVar1 < 0x52) and the presence predicate FUN_0802fe84.
fields.name: config_param_09

fields.description: Header configuration byte at save offset 0x0A (baseline 0x05)
fields.evidence: Non-blank header byte adjacent to config_param_09; same bounded-selection idiom as FUN_0802e300 (uVar1 < 0x52 bound, index stored to *DAT_0802e440) and presence check FUN_0802fe84.
fields.name: config_param_0a

fields.description: Header configuration byte at save offset 0x0B (baseline 0x05)
fields.evidence: Non-blank header byte adjacent to config_param_09/0a; same bounded-selection idiom as FUN_0802e300 (uVar1 < 0x52) with dispatch helpers FUN_0802e4a8 and FUN_0802e724.
fields.name: config_param_0b

fields.description: Selected profile/slot index byte at save offset 0x13 (baseline 0x03); index range 0..81 comes from the decomp unlock-gate bound
fields.evidence: FUN_08025f48 gates an entry index with (param_1 < 0x51) before consulting the unlock predicates FUN_0801693c and FUN_080169d0; the menu layer FUN_0802e300 likewise bounds a u16 selection (uVar1 < 0x52) and stores it to *DAT_0802e440.
fields.name: profile_select_index

fields.description: Slot/profile status code at save offset 0x14 (baseline 0x02); status codes 0/1/2/8/9 are the slot-list filter values
fields.evidence: Slot-list builders filter records by status: FUN_08017938 keeps records with *(short *)(iVar7 * 0x16 + iVar1) != 0, FUN_080179fc filters != 1, FUN_08017b10 filters != 2, and FUN_08017d00 treats codes 8 and 9 as special (compares against 8, then 9).
fields.name: profile_slot_status

fields.description: Secondary profile/sub index byte at save offset 0x15 (baseline 0x01)
fields.evidence: FUN_08017d00 switches on a (ushort)param_1[1] profile index against DAT_08017d6c[1] and walks a 0x16-stride record array; the same < 0x51 index bound from FUN_08025f48 applies to entry selection.
fields.name: profile_sub_index

fields.description: Slot active marker at save offset 0x17 (baseline 0xFF = erased/active); single-byte boolean idiom
fields.evidence: Boolean presence idiom FUN_0802fe84 (returns *DAT_0802fe94 == 1) and sentinel init FUN_080304b4 which presets table words to 0xFFFF; erased EEPROM reads 0xFF, matching the baseline value.
fields.name: slot_active_marker

fields.description: Unlock/progress bitflag bank covering save bytes 0x50..0x57 (baseline FF FF FF FF 00 00 00 00)
fields.evidence: Bit-test predicate FUN_0801693c checks bit (param_1 & 7) of byte ((param_1 & 0xff) >> 3) + DAT_08016960 + 0x1c; twin predicate FUN_080169d0 tests the same bit against table DAT_080169f4; setter FUN_08016990 sets bit (param_1 & 7) at ((param_1 & 0xff) >> 3) + DAT_080169cc; all gated by FUN_08025f48 index bound param_1 < 0x51.
fields.name: unlock_flags_bank0

fields.description: Unlock/progress bitflag bank covering save bytes 0x78..0x7F (baseline FF FF FF FF 00 00 FF FF)
fields.evidence: Same unlock bit-array idiom as bank0: bit tests FUN_0801693c (table DAT_08016960 + 0x1c) and FUN_080169d0 (table DAT_080169f4), bit setter FUN_08016990 (table DAT_080169cc), index bound param_1 < 0x51 in FUN_08025f48.
fields.name: unlock_flags_bank1

fields.description: Unlock/progress bitflag bank covering save bytes 0xA0..0xA7 (baseline FF FF FF FF 00 00 FF FF)
fields.evidence: Same unlock bit-array idiom: bit tests FUN_0801693c / FUN_080169d0 over tables DAT_08016960 + 0x1c and DAT_080169f4, setter FUN_08016990 over DAT_080169cc, gated by FUN_08025f48 (param_1 < 0x51).
fields.name: unlock_flags_bank2

fields.description: Unlock/progress bitflag bank covering save bytes 0xC8..0xCF (baseline 00 00 00 00 00 00 FF FF)
fields.evidence: Same unlock bit-array idiom: bit tests FUN_0801693c / FUN_080169d0, setter FUN_08016990, index bound param_1 < 0x51 in FUN_08025f48; this bank is fully cleared (unlocked) in baseline.
fields.name: unlock_flags_bank3

fields.description: Trailing record-table flags covering save bytes 0x16A..0x171 (baseline FF followed by seven 0x00)
fields.evidence: Record allocator FUN_08016a44 manages stride-0x10 records (state u16 at +0 flipped 0 -> 1, u32 payloads at +8/+0xC, live count at *DAT_08016aa8); table default-init FUN_080304b4 presets record words (base +8/+10/+12) to 0xFFFF.
fields.name: record_table_tail

fields.description: Trailing sentinel byte at save offset 0x173 (baseline 0xFF)
fields.evidence: Sentinel default-init idiom FUN_080304b4 presets table words to 0xFFFF (blank/erased state); erased EEPROM reads 0xFF, matching the baseline value at this tail offset.
fields.name: save_tail_marker
